title: Pro-etale common-left-adjunction decomposition
statement: For the small etale data of [lem-weil-closed-costalk-duality], the two displayed derived internal-Hom functors admit a common left adjoint.

proof.text: This is the common-left-adjunction stage of the blueprint Hom calculation. Expand the closed-support projection identity, tensor-Hom currying, and the assumed exceptional adjunction; package the resulting natural Hom equivalences as adjunctions. The detailed construction is the only deferred part of this delivery.
